title: Unloaded transcript inserts can shrink the known message count
outcome: sync_retained_transcript_metadata always replaces session.message_count with message_start_index plus the resident message length. insert_message_on_record calls it for every insert, including remote proxy/tail records where messages_loaded is false and message_count may represent a larger authoritative transcript. A remote non-tail message or command/parallel-agent insert can therefore regress the known total and publish an incorrect smaller count.
acceptance: For records with messagesLoaded=false, insert and update paths never reduce an existing authoritative messageCount; they preserve max(existing count, retained end) or use an equivalent explicit invariant. Remote MessageCreated, CommandUpdate, and ParallelAgentsUpdate edge cases have regressions proving SSE and persisted counts remain monotonic.
